svg.text: Single common ground — all modules + PSUs
① ADS1115 A0–A3: 100nF ceramic cap to GND on each input (C1–C4)
② MCP4728 on 5V via BSS138 shifter — ADS1115/MCP23017 on 3.3V only
③ DS18B20: one R_PU = 4.7kΩ to +3.3V for the entire 1-Wire bus
④ I²C: onboard pull-ups on ADS1115 — do not stack multiple pull-ups
⑤ SM6004 current loop: 24V → SM6004 → XY-IT0V → 0–3.3V → ADS1115
⑥ SM6004 OUT1 (flow) used · OUT2 not connected
⑦ SSR: GPIO direct drive (3.3V → optocoupler input, no level shift needed)
⑧ Schematic must be updated with every wiring change (steering rule)
AN1 (RIMS): SM6004 #1 → XY-IT0V #1 → ADS1115 A2 → sensor.singularity_an1_rate
AN2 (Sparge): SM6004 #2 → XY-IT0V #2 → ADS1115 A3 → sensor.singularity_an2_rate
Slope: 7.57 L/min per volt · Offset: number entity (flash-persisted)
